external_dependencies.description: All pages load external CSS and JS from byattari.com
external_dependencies.details: Pages use addStylesheet() and addScript() to load 40-80 external resources per page

iframe_usage.description: Many pages contain iframes (likely for maps or embedded content)
iframe_usage.details: 67 files have 1 iframe, 5 files have 2 iframes, 15 files have 3 iframes

no_modular_structure.description: No proper React component structure exists
no_modular_structure.details: Missing components/, layouts/, routes/, hooks/, utils/, styles/ directories

duplicate_components.description: Multiple duplicate page components with hash suffixes

must_do: Create modular folder structure (components, layouts, pages, routes, hooks, utils, styles)
Extract shared components (Header, Footer, Navigation, etc.)
Convert all pages to proper React functional components
Remove external CSS/JS loading and migrate to local imports
Convert iframe usage to proper React components
Migrate all inline event handlers to React events
Fix all asset paths to use proper imports
should_do: Remove duplicate files (keep only one version per group)
Create reusable UI components (Button, Card, Modal, etc.)
Implement proper state management with hooks
challenges: Large number of pages (156) with complex dependencies
Heavy external resource loading needs to be localized
No existing component architecture to build upon
Original HTML structure was not designed for React

phase_1.name: Structure Setup
tasks: Create new project with proper folder structure
Set up shared utilities and hooks

phase_2.name: Component Extraction
tasks: Set up CSS modules or styled-components

phase_3.name: Page Conversion
tasks: Convert pages one by one starting with simpler ones

notes: This is a large-scale reconstruction requiring systematic approach. The current state is a basic HTML-to-JSX conversion that needs complete restructuring to become a proper React application.
